title: Example voice-note workflow
target_user: People who capture frequent voice notes
core_job: Turn spoken thoughts into organized actions
trigger: A thought is captured while the user cannot type
current_alternative: Transcription plus notes plus task manager
improvement_points: Convert one recording into a structured summary and next actions
minimum_build: Record, transcribe, summarize, and confirm actions
stop_conditions: Fewer than three repeated workaround patterns are found
